mapper.sql: SELECT l.lock_id, l.tenant_id, l.dept_id, l.room_id, l.lock_type, l.lock_start_time, l.lock_end_time, l.lock_reason, l.lock_status, l.unlock_time, l.unlock_by, l.unlock_reason, l.create_dept, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, d.dept_name, r.room_number, u.nick_name AS unlock_by_name FROM pms_room_locks l LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON l.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN pms_room_rooms r ON l.room_id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.unlock_by = u.user_id WHERE l.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: AND l.room_id = #{roomId} AND l.lock_status = 'active' AND (l.lock_end_time IS NULL OR l.lock_end_time > NOW()) ORDER BY l.lock_start_time DESC
AND l.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY l.lock_start_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_room_locks WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND lock_status = 'active' AND del_flag = '0' AND ( (lock_start_time <= #{startTime} AND (lock_end_time IS NULL OR lock_end_time >= #{startTime})) OR (lock_start_time <= #{endTime} AND (lock_end_time IS NULL OR lock_end_time >= #{endTime})) OR (lock_start_time >= #{startTime} AND lock_start_time <= #{endTime}) )
AND lock_id != #{excludeId}
